recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a high-contrast, sepia-toned male portrait framed by a thick white border. The top section contains a horizontal red rule and bold sans-serif text, interrupted by a circular graphic badge containing a silhouette.
coreVisualRelationships: Portrait centered within a secondary interior frame
Circular badge overlapping the top horizontal rule and text
High-contrast warm lighting against a textured, dark background
Bold red typography contrasting with the neutral white and sepia palette
coreInvariants: Horizontal red line spanning the top third
Circular graphic element in the upper right quadrant
Warm, golden-brown color grading on the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up headshot centered vertically and horizontally within the inner frame, filling approximately 60% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned at the vertical center of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold red text at the top, moves to the circular badge, then drops down to the central portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial white border provides breathing room and emphasizes the central square image.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white border and dark portrait; high saturation in the red accents against the desaturated sepia.

composition.position: Top margin, above the red rule

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all text to maintain minimalist 80s modernism.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 80s aesthetic and circular counters.
Provides a similar weight and classic display feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast sepia-toned male portrait in a dark suit against a textured brown background. Place this image inside a square frame centered on a white canvas. Add a thin red horizontal line across the top white margin.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in red above the red line. Place a circular badge with a black silhouette and a red/white double border in the upper right, overlapping the text and the red line.

verificationChecks: Is the text uppercase and red?
Is the portrait sepia-toned and high contrast?
Does the circular badge overlap the top text line?
Is there a thick white border around the central square image?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist

mustAchieve: Balanced negative space in the margins

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red line is perfectly horizontal.
Verify the circular badge is perfectly round and centered on the line.
Check that the sepia tones do not bleed into the white border.
Confirm the text tracking is consistent and wide.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square portrait + white border + top-aligned bold sans-serif text + intersecting circular graphic badge.
